maddeler.e:
استكرين (form X)
# اِسْتَكْرَيْنَ (istakrayna) /is.tak.raj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
# اُسْتُكْرِينَ (ustukrīna) /us.tuk.riː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
# اِسْتَكْرِينَ (istakrīna) /is.tak.riː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
